speaker: Doctor
text: The rash sounds like it might be affecting areas exposed to the sun, and the nerve symptoms on your palms are concerning. Do you have any difficulty walking, weakness in your legs, or changes in your bowel or bladder habits?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow thinning, and neuropathy is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Acid-Fast_Bacilli_Stain

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal acid-fast stain makes typical leprosy less likely, but the combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow loss, and neuropathy in a rice farmer is classic for Pantothenate Kinase-Associated Neurodegeneration (PKAN) or more likely, a specific nutritional deficiency or environmental exposure like Arsenic or Chronic Beryllium Disease, but given the specific triad, I suspect Pellagra or a similar deficiency. Let me check your dietary history and skin lesions more closely.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease) - Tuberculoid form
